prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept / reference-guided original game character design.
Asset type: Phase 1 concept approval image ONLY for Thien Son (Thiên Sơn), Võ Lâm Hero Defense; not a sprite atlas or animation asset.
Reference roles: artwork/thieu-lam-thien-son.png supplies ONLY the upper Thiên Sơn character costume/hair/fan/dao direction, NOT its ice/snow motifs and NOT the lower monk. assets/references/vo_dang_character_reference.png supplies detailed chibi pixel-art proportions and elevated overworld camera. assets/exports/characters/hero_cai_bang_idle.png supplies the approved compact gameplay hero proportions/style baseline, NOT its red outfit or staff. Draw new original pixels. Do not crop, trace or paste any reference sprite.
Primary request: ONE handsome young aristocratic male martial artist, full body, elegant compact chibi about 2.5 heads tall, head roughly 40-45 percent of total height as in approved Cái Bang. Layered white and warm ivory silk wuxia martial robes, pale sky-blue inner folds and jade-green trim/sash, restrained silver clasps and delicate wind-scroll embroidery concentrated at collar/cuffs/hem. Long dark charcoal hair, refined aristocratic topknot, small silver/jade hair fastener and two flowing ivory/pale-blue ribbons. Warm natural skin, clear dark eyes, handsome composed expression. Lightweight split robe hems, trousers and small dark blue-gray shoes visible. Refined tailoring and clean silhouette contrast with Cái Bang rustic costume. No armor, crown or fur.
Signature weapon: hold ONE fully OPEN folding combat FAN in anatomical right hand, out to the character's side at about chest height so its broad scalloped semicircular silhouette, visible radial dark-jade/silver ribs and ivory silk leaf are immediately recognizable without covering face/torso. Fan has elegant jade edge and simple wind-scroll decoration, practical scale around torso width. Secondary curved Chinese dao in a slim jade-gray curved scabbard at anatomical left hip, silver curved hilt visible, one coherent blade/scabbard only. Keep accessory placements clear and suitable for later four-direction continuity.
Element WIND (Phong): a few thin directional pale jade/sky-blue air wisps separated from the body, and natural wind flutter in ribbon, sleeve tips and robe hems; keep them sparse so costume and feet stay clear. No ice, frost, snowflakes, icicles, crystals, snow or frozen aura. Avoid reading as an ice mage.
Style/medium: detailed polished chibi wuxia PIXEL ART with crisp stepped selective dark outlines, deliberate visible pixel clusters, controlled material color ramps, upper-left highlights, rich yet restrained 16-bit RPG detail. Match the existing character references and approved Cái Bang scale/proportions. Not a smooth anime painting, vector icon, 3D render or crude 8-bit block figure. Concept enlargement only; production gameplay frames will be freshly authored later, approximately 44 logical pixels body height on the established 80x80 canvas after approval.
Composition: square clean concept presentation, ONE dominant full-body character centered with generous clear margins, stable orthographic slightly elevated top-down three-quarter OVERWORLD perspective, top of head and shoulders visible, face/front and short grounded feet visible, facing slightly toward viewer and screen left. No camera foreshortening, no isometric diamond grid and no eye-level side-scroller pose. Entire hair/ribbons/fan/scabbard/feet in frame, no crop. Plain muted dark desaturated blue-green background lets white/ivory robe edges read. A small restrained contact shadow only. No landscape, no UI, no other characters, no alternate poses, no detail insets, no grids, no text, no labels, no logos or watermark. Fan must be visibly held with plausible hand grip. Preserve ivory fabric mass with dark blue-gray outline/shadow contrast; light-blue/jade are accents rather than replacing white robes.
